phase1_initial_proposals.technology_specification: Capacitive soil moisture sensor probe integrated with a microcontroller unit (MCU) and wireless radio module for real-time soil moisture monitoring in agricultural environments. This device measures soil dielectric permittivity to estimate moisture content, processes data via an embedded MCU, and transmits readings wirelessly for remote sensing.
phase1_initial_proposals.technology_reasoning: Capacitive soil moisture sensors are the predominant type in precision agriculture due to their reliability, low power consumption, and reduced corrosion compared to resistive sensors. Integration with an MCU enables local data processing, while the radio module supports telemetry, commonly using industry-standard wireless protocols like LoRa or BLE, making this configuration widely adopted for smart farming applications.
